sentences.text: By this petition under Section 482 r/w Sections 397 and 401 of the Cr.P.C., the petitioner has prayed for quashing of the Charge Sheet No. 45/16 arising out of Moirabari P.S. Case No. 42/2014 under Sections 419/420 of the IPC r/w Section 67 of the IT Act.
Notice in this case was served on the respondent No. 2 by registered A/D post personally on 16.01.2023, vide acknowledgement card.
But despite being shown and fixing date for appearance, he has not appeared either himself or through any counsel.
Scanned copy of the case record is received.

Mr. R. J. Baruah, learned Addl. P.P., submits that the technical ground cited by the petitioner can be considered by the learned Trial Court in the course of the trial of the case or at the time of consideration of the charges.

Upon perusal of the case record and having considered the fact that the respondent No. 2, despite service of notice, has not turned up, this Court finds it appropriate to grant interim stay in the proceeding of the case.

Accordingly, it is provided that till appearance of the respondent No. 2, further proceeding in Moirabari P.S. Case No. 42/2014, corresponding to G.R. Case No. 398/2014, pending in the Court of learned Addl. C.J.M., Morigaon, shall remain stayed.
List this matter after 5 (five) weeks.
